#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

vector<long long> a;
bool ans;
int n;
long long leftsum, rightsum;

void pos(int x) {
    if (x == n) {
        if (leftsum == rightsum) {
            ans = true;
        }
        return;
    }
    if (ans) {
        return;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
        if (ans) {
            return;
        }
        if (i == 1) {
            leftsum += a[x];
            pos(x + 1);
            leftsum -= a[x];
        } else if (i == 2) {
            rightsum += a[x];
            pos(x + 1);
            rightsum -= a[x];
        } else {
            pos(x + 1);
        }
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    long long w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    long long limit = 100000000000LL;
    a.resize(40);
    int z = 1;
    long long temp = 1;
    a[0] = 1;
    if (w <= 3) {
        cout << "YES\n";
        return 0;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < 16; i++) {
        a[z] = temp * w;
        temp = temp * w;
        if (temp > limit) {
            break;
        }
        z++;
    }
    leftsum = 0;
    rightsum = m;
    n = z;
    ans = false;
    pos(0);
    if (ans) {
        cout << "YES\n";
    } else {
        cout << "NO\n";
    }
    return 0;
}
